title: 131 drones intercepted
description: Ukraine was attacked this night by 131 drones, including Shahed strike UAVs (including jet ones), Gerbera, Italmas and parody drones of the Parody type. As reported by the Air Force, 107 drones were shot down/suppressed in the north, south, center and east of the country. 16 strike UAVs were recorded at 9 locations, as well as downed (debris) at 6 locations.
description_en: Ukraine was attacked this night by 131 drones, including Shahed strike UAVs (including jet ones), Gerbera, Italmas and parody drones of the Parody type. Как сообщают Воздушные силы, было сбито/подавлено 107 дронов на севере, юге, центре и востоке страны. Зафиксировано попадание 16 ударных БпЛА на 9 локациях, а также падение сбитых (обломки) на 6 локациях.
